96k — разговор и подкаст. 128k — приемле: 96k for speech and podcasts. 128k is acceptable for music. 160–192k is music with no audible difference. 256k and above has headroom.
Поворот на 90° меняет местами ширину и в: A 90° rotation swaps width and height. Handy for phone video that the player shows sideways.

Intel Quick Sync — блок кодирования встр: Intel Quick Sync — the encoding block of Intel integrated graphics. Fast and barely loads the processor; quality sits between NVENC and libx264.
veryslow даёт файл примерно на 20% меньш: veryslow gives a file about 20% smaller than medium at the same quality, but encodes several times longer. ultrafast is the opposite.
Замеряет воспринимаемую громкость по ста: It measures perceived loudness to the EBU R128 standard and pulls it to −16 LUFS — the level video platforms normalise to.
Файл выйдет на 3–5% меньше заказанного:: The file comes out 3–5% under what you asked for: the remainder is left for container headers. The shorter the clip, the higher the quality at the same size.
Постоянное качество лучше, когда файл ни: Constant quality is better when the file need not fit anywhere. Target size is for a hard limit: an email attachment, a messenger upload.
«Постоянное качество» — вы называете кач: “Constant quality” — you name the quality and the size comes out as it comes. “Target file size” — you name the size and the bitrate is worked out from it.
Битрейт видео считается из этого размера: The video bitrate is worked out from this size and the duration, less whatever the sound will take. Mebibytes are the same units Windows Explorer shows.
Снижение с 60 до 30 убирает примерно чет: Dropping from 60 to 30 removes about a quarter of the weight, but fast motion becomes less smooth. Raising the rate is pointless — frames would simply be duplicated.
Уменьшение стороны вдвое (1080p → 540p): Halving a side (1080p → 540p) cuts the file by roughly four times. It is the most effective way to reduce weight if the video is watched on a phone anyway.
Первый проход ничего не пишет — он тольк: The first pass writes nothing — it only looks for the difficult scenes. The second hands out bits knowingly: less to calm frames, more to movement.
NVIDIA NVENC — кодирует отдельный блок в: NVIDIA NVENC — encoding on a dedicated block of the graphics card. Five to fifteen times faster than the processor, but at the same file size the picture is noticeably coarser than libx264/libx265.
libx265 — программный HEVC. При том же к: libx265 — software HEVC. At the same quality the file is about a third smaller than H.264, but it encodes several times longer, and older devices will not open such video.
Тихая запись станет слышной, слишком гро: A quiet recording becomes audible; an over-loud one stops hurting the ear. Several clips from different sources will sound alike, with no need to reach for the volume between them.
0 is lossless (the file grows larger than the source). 18–22 is indistinguishable from the original. 23–27 is good for most purposes. 28 and above shows blocking and smearing. AV1 and VP9 run to 63, not 51.
Быстрая обрезка мгновенна и не теряет ка: A fast trim is instant and loses no quality, but the start may drift by a couple of seconds. A precise trim lands frame for frame, yet takes as long as ordinary re-encoding.
Каждая строка называет и кодек, и устрой: Every entry names both the codec and the device: “Processor (CPU)” or a specific graphics card. Only those hardware options are shown for which the system has a suitable card.
На больших мониторах и экранах с высокой: On large monitors and high-density screens the interface stops being small. The window itself is not stretched — the content simply scrolls if it no longer fits.
Шум — самое дорогое, что есть в кадре: о: Noise is the most expensive thing in a frame: it is random and does not compress. Remove it and the file gets noticeably smaller at the same CRF. Overdo it and fine detail goes along with the noise.
Кодировщик сам решает, сколько бит потра: The encoder decides for itself how many bits each frame gets, so long as quality holds at the level you set. The file size is not known in advance: a calm frame takes little, a scene with rain takes a lot.
Копирование идёт почти мгновенно и не те: Copying is near-instant and loses not a gram of quality, but it will not shrink the size either: the data is the same. It requires the container to accept the codec — MP4 will not take ASS subtitles, for instance.
В видео можно начать воспроизведение не: Playback can start not on any frame but only on a keyframe — those come every few seconds. A fast trim steps back to the nearest one; a precise trim re-encodes the beginning to land where you asked.
H.264 откроется где угодно. H.265 при то: H.264 opens anywhere. H.265 at the same quality gives a file about a third smaller, but encodes longer and is not understood by every device. A graphics card encodes many times faster, but at equal file size the picture is coarser.
